description: This file defines an abstract class 'BackupSource' that extends 'StagedBackup' and declares two abstract methods 'valid' and 'next'. It serves as a base class for backup source implementations in the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: BackupSource
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for backup source implementations, extending StagedBackup and declaring abstract methods 'valid' and 'next'.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: An abstract method to check if the backup source is valid.

methods.name: next
methods.description: An abstract method to proceed to the next step or item in the backup process.
